title: Commonwealth Gas Company files, pursuant to M.G.L. Chapter 164, Section 94, for the Department's review and approval of an agreement for quasi-firm transportation service agreement with Natick Paperboard Corporation.
filings: The Department of Telecommunications and Energy hereby APPROVES the Agreement. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr.
